text:
Ana: Heads up — Symphony marketplace + SI integration is targeting next-month GA. Need to align on MDF ask, co-marketing, and a QBR slot for a tier review. Quick sync?
Mike: Yup — sounds good. What are the pieces we need to budget for? Announcement + webinar + enablement for SI?
Talia: Need a rough budget ask first. Also specify whether MDF is one-time or a run-rate commitment.
Ana: Initial thinking: $40k co-marketing (ads, email, landing) + $25k MDF for SI enablement (training, joint demos). Proposal doc: https://redwood.internal/symphony-prop (will attach SOW when ready).
Jyoti: Product update: integration feature-freeze is planned for 03/28. Security review queued, ETA 04/02. Webinar earliest viable date looks like 04/10.
Kai: Scorecard note: Symphony currently Tier 2. Proposal to offer conditional Tier 1 ("Strategic Marketplace") tied to a 90-day performance ramp (leads -> pipeline conversion targets). Thoughts?
Mike: I like conditional bump. For QBR slide we should ask for 1 slide + 2 min to present. KPIs: marketplace installs, leads generated, closed ARR.
Talia: Finance can greenlight up to $65k total if we have: (a) SOW for the $25k enablement, (b) a simple SLA/commit on co-marketing deliverables, and (c) GL code to tag spend.
Ana: I'll get SOW from Symphony and draft the SLA. Also proposing a short clause: "tier bump contingent on hitting 70% of KPIs in 90 days."
Jyoti: Product ok with the clause as long as security checks pass. We'll prioritize the security review for this partner.
PartnerBot: Reminder — Quarterly partner scorecards publish Friday 10:00am. :bell:
Kai: I'll draft the scorecard update and the conditional tier language. Mike — can you drop webinar agenda bullets by EOD?
Mike: On it. Also looping in Legal for co-marketing T&Cs (cc @Legal).
Talia: Finance notes: tag MDF spend to GL 4-32-77. We'll create PO once SOW is in.
Ana: Quick availability check — 30m sync today at 16:00 PT? React with ✅ if you can.
Jyoti: ✅
Mike: ✅
Talia: ✅
Kai: ✅ — I'll bring the draft scorecard and the tier wording.
Ana: Great — thanks everyone. I'll drop the proposal + link to SOW draft in the thread when I have it.
Kai: Noted — will follow up after the meeting with action items and a short checklist (SOW, PO, webinar content, KPI tracking sheet).
